records.title: TAPNext++: What's Next for Tracking Any Point (TAP)?
records.reason: arXiv abstract: recurrent transformer tracks visual points in video; efficiency is the tracking model footprint, outside LLM inference optimization.

records.title: FoundRoot: Towards Foundation Model for Root Cause Analysis via Structured Deep Thinking
records.reason: The linked root-cause-analysis lineage makes a body check necessary, but the ACM DOI landing/full-text retrieval failed in the browser (Internal Error) and no publisher-authored full text was available in the packet. The abstract alone cannot establish whether a concrete inference/runtime method exists, so it remains borderline rather than excluded.

records.title: RemoteAgent: Bridging Vague Human Intents and Earth Observation With RL-Based Agentic MLLMs
records.reason: arXiv abstract: Earth-observation agent uses RL and specialized vision tools for spatial prediction; no LLM inference efficiency mechanism is evaluated.

records.title: RoboAgent: Chaining Basic Capabilities for Embodied Task Planning
records.reason: arXiv abstract: embodied planning pipeline trains a VLM scheduler/capability system for robotics; the stated contribution is planning capability, not inference resource reduction.

records.title: ThinkTwice: Jointly Optimizing Large Language Models for Reasoning and Self-Refinement
records.reason: arXiv abstract and primary HTML §§3–5: ThinkTwice trains reasoning/self-refinement with RL; reported gains and 3% training overhead/16% training-time convergence improvement concern post-training, while test-time self-refinement adds another generation rather than reducing inference cost.
